question: Find Breast trials with median follow‑up and show months by arm.

llama.answer: Breast trials with median follow-up and follow-up duration by arm.
llama.raw: {"sql":"SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"cancer_type\", \"follow_up_type\", \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" = 'Breast' AND \"follow_up_type\" ILIKE '%median%' AND \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\" IS NOT NULL AND \"follow_up_duration_control_months\" IS NOT NULL;","answer":"Breast trials with median follow-up and follow-up duration by arm.","assumptions":""}
